title: Order Listeners
statement: Implement `solve(listeners, event)`. `listeners` is a list of names. Notify a snapshot of that list with `event`. Return `[name:event, ...]` in the snapshot order. Take the snapshot before you notify, so the result length matches the input length even if a listener would have unsubscribed itself. You do not need to mutate the list. Just notify the copy.
constraints: Every current listener is notified once
hints: Build name:event for each copied name.
Do not iterate the live list if you also delete from it. The copy is the point.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An observer list mutated during notification skips or double-calls.

editorial: An observer list mutated during notification skips or double-calls. Iterating a copy, or iterating a snapshot of the names, freezes the set of recipients for this event. The result is that snapshot's messages, in order.
